import bisect

class FenwickTree:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.n = size
        self.tree = [0] * (self.n + 1)  # 1-based indexing

    def update(self, index, delta):
        while index <= self.n:
            self.tree[index] += delta
            index += index & -index

    def query(self, index):
        res = 0
        while index > 0:
            res += self.tree[index]
            index -= index & -index
        return res

        return []

    sorted_unique = sorted(set(nums))
    n = len(nums)
    result = [0] * n
    ft = FenwickTree(len(sorted_unique))
    
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        x = nums[i]
        # Find the rank of the current element
        rank = bisect.bisect_left(sorted_unique, x) + 1  # 1-based indexing
        # Query the number of elements smaller than x
        count = ft.query(rank - 1)
        result[i] = count
        # Update the Fenwick Tree with the current element
        ft.update(rank, 1)
